generations.conceptPrompt: A 1989 coal-fired ore smelting furnace for a quarry works yard: a squat welded steel box lined with firebrick, a heavy front fire door, a charging hatch on top and a short chimney stack. A squat riveted dark steel box on a brick plinth, a heavy arched fire door with a handle on the front, a round hatch lid on top, a short stack at the back. Single object, orthographic-style three-quarter product shot from slightly above, the whole object in frame, plain flat light grey background, soft even studio light, no hands, no stand, no text, no logos, no watermark.
